system.description: Make eye contact with your subject, spend Mental Traits equal to his total permanent Willpower Traits, and initiate a Social Challenge. If you win, his Nature changes to one of your choice, permanently, until undone by another Restructure. If you lose, including all retests, the victim may spend a Willpower Trait to initiate a Social Challenge against you; if he wins, your own Nature changes to his Nature for the next lunar month.
